description: grid-datasets, published by panaschristou, indexes simulated distribution-grid reconfiguration datasets for language-model research. Coverage: The listed study cases include 33-, 37-, 69-, 84- and 121-node systems and combined grids, with processed and raw simulation variants. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is Apache-2.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The repository points to one LLM-based reconfiguration study. Its Apache code/repository label does not automatically establish the terms of every linked Hugging Face dataset. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
